response: {"thought": "語意層沒有對應「物流商」「配送天數」，我先用 shipments 的 shipped_ts 篩出 2025 年第二季的已送達出貨單，計算配送天數的合計平均，並檢查負值、異常值與時間格式。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days, MIN(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS max_days, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts < shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(shipped_ts) <> 19 OR LENGTH(delivered_ts) <> 19 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_format_cnt FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01' AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL", "SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01' AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY carrier", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days_by_delivered_q2 FROM shipments WHERE delivered_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND delivered_ts < '2025-07-01' AND shipped_ts IS NOT NULL", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_shipment_order_pairs FROM (SELECT order_id FROM shipments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)"]}}
